text:
Very disappointing and expensive. Took a couple of family members out for lunch first week in September.  Thought they'd enjoy a " nicer" place 
Service ok.
Food below average. Fries cool, floppy, absolute nothing special. For the prices charged I expect a lot more!

The lamb barbacoa tacos one of the best things I've ever had!!! Omg! I didn't even know they make barbacoa with lamb. We also tried the crane Asada and the Mexican fried rice, both great. Love this place

Okay, this was a bit pricey but absolutely worth it. The duck fat carrots were probably one of the most transformative dishes I have ever tasted. I have always said cooked carrots were, "meh," but after this I was left wondering if I just had one of the best dishes I've ever had! Would highly recommend.

The woman who takes orders is so happy and sweet. It's impossible to see her and not smile. I ordered vegetarian dumplings. They were well made and had a simple flavor. I'd like to go back and try the vegetarian pies next time. The food is decently priced.

The food was good but in short supply.  They were running out of all of the proteins which are pretty important to creating a poke bowl.  The people were nice and friendly but I would recommend ordering almost as soon as they open so that you can have what you want and not just what's still available

Great food. Great environment. Pricey.
If you want one of the best you will find it here.
Special place for a special, nice evening.

My favorite Polish grocery! Definitely a plus if you actually speak a Slavic language, but growing up in a Ukrainian/Italian home made me appreciate the authenticity! Delicious homemade pierogies, sausage of many varieties

Yoooo this place is so good. Came here twice on our trip to SB hoping to get fresh uni but the weather was really bad and the fishermen weren't able to go out. 

Despite the initial disappointment, we were really pleased with the other stuff we purchased. We got sashimi'd Scottish salmon and also ahi tuna which was on sale!! The sales are sooo worth it. Also the people that work here totally know their stuff. They're rly rly helpful in choosing what you want and really patient! Got some confusing information though because the first guy that helped us the first day gave us a student discount on everything but the second guy the next day said sashimi'd stuff can't be discounted which didn't rly make sense to me since we already paid a 2$ up charge to get it cut that way.

We also got oysters from here - some freshwater ones from Virginia and also some Laguna ones from Mexico. Laguna ones were SOOOO good. Really clean and strong taste. Virginia ones weren't as flavorful to me but super clean! Definitely want to come back here and would recommend to anyone that wants fresh seafood.

Great find!! Tucked next to other businesses on a busy street, this was well worth the time to find parking. Excellent service, and my beef shawarma sandwich was fantastic. They build it with whatever toppings you like, then wrap it up and hand it over. Just make sure you have lots of napkins if you like extra sauce like I do. Can't wait to go back!

Pomodoro Pizza is a place I've been meaning to try for a while and now I'm kicking myself for not doing it sooner! From the pictures people have posted this looks like a cute little strip mall pizza place. I've only ordered delivery and each time the food felt like it just came out of the oven. I'm slowly making their way through the menu and I've been quite pleased with what I've had so far. Their thin crust pizza hit the spot and I even ate some of the crust, which I normally don't do. The cheese ravioli and subs were also good, with the calzones being my favorite. The cheese filling of the calzone was absolutely delicious and it's going to be hard for me not to order it every time. The only thing that I disliked was the garlic knots, which were overcooked and hard to chew. I can't wait to work my way through more of the menu!

We love Tacconellis and it's right in our neighborhood so this is where we ordered for #yelpsbignightin Plus we love Bridget and the rest of the waitresses and wanted to support them. It was the same process for takeout as eat in. You need to order your dough starting at 10 am. They're usually sold out by noon! The reason you order your dough is that Tacconellis has an old brick pizza oven that only cooks so many perfect pies. I've been going here since I was a little girl. It's still the same delicious pizza! 
The pizza is thin crust with a slightly sweet sauce and the perfect amount of cheese on the plain. The spinach and tomato is one of the best! We get it every time! It just has the right amount of spinach and tomato with that thin crackly crust! All the pizzas are delicious! The sausage is another fave of ours It was just as delicious for takeout as it is to eat in.
It's BYOB so we enjoyed wine from Cape May Winery!

I had been wanting to try Masala Kitchen for a while, so I was excited to finally order their signature dish. Unfortunately, the MK' Special Chicken and Lamb Platter was just so-so. Portion size was huge, but the flavor profile was strange to me and not very authentic. It felt like a mish-mash of tons of different ingredients, rather than a well-crafted dish. Maybe take the advice of other reviewers and try the rolls or the biriyani dishes. I'd like to check those out - hopefully they're better!
My favorite sushi restaurant in Indianapolis, I always order a mango roll. I also recommend it to others looking for a sushi place.

OMG!!! It's the BEST in Philadelphia!!!! 
Fking love this place. 
The flavor is good, way better than ones in center city & other spots in philly. Love this place. And the price is reasonable!!!

My wife and I were in Tucson for work and this place was close to the Sheraton where we were staying so we got dinner to go. We each got a carne asada burrito with rice & pinto beans. Pinto beans seems to be the only beans they offer. The flavor in the burrito was good on first bite, but the meat was of extremely poor quality with lots of fatty pieces. We each ended up throwing most of it away. Very disappointed based on some of the good reviews we saw on Yelp prior to deciding. We have yet to be impressed by any restaurant in Tucson and this little place was no exception.

Food was ok. Being Hispanic, the flavor of food was disappointing. Cuban sandwich was not authentic and the steak had no flavor and did not come with the onions that had to be asked for. The roasted pork was fine but black beans also had no real seasoning. Service was fine but probably won't be back

The worst customer service I have ever received. The waitress not only forgot parts of our order she had to be reminded about what she forgot. Never once was an apology given. We will NEVER be back to this location.

Piping hot pho with a ton of veggies (bean spouts, onions, basil, cilantro) large portion of chicken & noodles. 
Pretty good but the chicken was too chewy, almost rubber like, so had the pho less the meat. Also had a grilled pork banh mi sandwich, which was tasty. Fresh French baguette. Would go again but not have the chicken pho.

My best friend brought me here for a date night. It wasn't busy so that was a lie because we both were famished. I was a bit confused as to when we were seated and we left a space between us the hostess told us to sit back next to each other "for social distancing" I guess my definition is different. Nonetheless the food was AMAZING! Way better than any hibachi place I've ever visited, and better than Benihana. I will always come back when I'm back home visiting my family/friends. Portions are a good size as well.

Let me just start out to say... this place was very unique and great for my first time. My girlfriend and I were looking for a new coffee shop, and this place was it! It is ran by this older couple that have their casual bicker wars which is quite comedic and feels friendly. The singers that happened to walk in seem like regulars and are actually pretty great and have an array of songs they go through. The variety of items and the relaxed environment is one for all to be welcomed into. Be aware that they cant use their computer system fully yet but has potential.

Favorite Indian restaurant in Santa Barbara!! Kind, family owned, great service. Recommend the korma and masala. The lunch buffet is also a fantastic option, it's a great price and comes with rice and naan. We've been here twice and will definitely come again!

If I could give this negative stars I would
DO NOT EVER ORDER CURBSIDE TAKEOUT ON NEW YEARS EVE!!
Food was horrible almost like you were a afterthought 
We ordered 3 sirloins and a onion mum
Steaks were tough very fatty
And mum was extremely greasy 

It was very busy had to wait a little extra which i did not mind thinking we were getting hot quality food- Not!!
Very Very disappointing
We have ordered takeout from here multiple times and it is always a great experience! Drunken noodles, crab rangoons, and panang curry are my go to.

I just see the name and start salivating. I think we can all agree it's one of the best in Indy. Bummer that it's on the north side, so we don't get there as much as we would if it was downtown, but still love it when we do. It's the high end of Cunningham Group restaurants, which I can't say enough good things about. Our community is so lucky to have such culinary explorers; such classy, community contributors. They make Indy a better place and one of their restaurants is almost always our go-to's.

I ordered a yogurt and pancakes for pickup.The app said 30 minutes which is crazy. If I ate inside I would hope to get it sooner. It was 3:00 in the afternoon. I didn't have time for dining in so I opted for pick-up. I checked in early around 15 minutes after I ordered to make sure it wasn't a glitch in the app and had to wait another 35 min until it was ready. There were very few people there. The yogurt had the granola mixed in it which it is usually on the side and by the time I got home it was all soggy. The pancakes were good and heated up well. The cashiers were really rude and not helpful when I asked them where my order was.

We Yelped this location and we are happy we did. 
The Cuban was AMAZING. The RedEye was PERFECT! They were also very nice and patient with us asking a million questions.

Yelp's Big Night In Choice! 

With everything going on currently, Ben as been doing deliveries to bring in cash and has told me about his pick ups from this place a few times already, that 1. he gets orders from there often, sometimes multiple times in 1 night and 2. that every time he picks up the food smells amazing and makes him hungry. Okay, sounds like a place we should try out then and it's less than a mile from our place. So, I had my personal driver go get it for me... I mean us! LOL. 

For our appetizer we got the Thai Spring Rolls and I gotta say, this one was a complete miss for me. They were kinda dry on the inside and they needed to be fried longer to make the rice paper crunchy. Ben liked them though. 

I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai cause if a Thai place can't make that correctly, well then you know... BUT mine was very good! I am pretty particular on how I like certain things and normally I would order extra chicken and bean sprouts but I wanted to see how it came normally and true to form, I would still order the extras. Many people like this dish but do not like the amount of peanuts on it so I do have to say that though mine had it on there, it wasn't overwhelming like some places can be. 

Ben ordered the Pad Kee Mow and when he walked in the door with our food, I instantly could smell his! He got his with medium spice to it and as a suggestion, I would request them to stir or mix it in with the entire dish. He discovered that all his spice was right in th

We tried to come here last weekend but were told the kitchen was an hour behind. we finally went last night (Friday) and the place was fairly empty. Tried to order the pulled pork sandwich but they were out . was told the soup of the day was Italian wedding but when we ordered they were out. We settled on theRosemary roast beef and brie sandwich and fries and a cup of chili. The sandwich had little flavor and I couldn't find the Brie. The couple of fries were like ore-ida seasoned fries from the oven and were not hot. The chili was super spicy hot and my wife couldn't finish it. The service was slow even though there was nobody in the place. We really wanted to like this place due to the proximity to butler. The only reason for two stars was the Guinness on tap was good.
Wonderful food. You will not leave hungry. I had the giant mahi taco and my husband had the Cajun fish and chips. The pies looked so good that we took two home for later

To paraphrase an infamous Seinfeld line, "they know how to take the reservation, but they don't know how to make the reservation". The first time I went here, they got my order wrong and charged me for an extra I didn't get. The second time, it took over 45 minutes to get an egg sandwich, which is a bit (a lot) much. As the saying goes: time is money - literally in this case as I had to keep refilling the parking meter. 

Certainly this is an adorable spot and I know these are difficult times (though they clearly aren't lacking customers), so I wish them luck in getting their act together.

Addendum: it's only fair that I relay the food I've eaten there has been delicious (pork roll egg and cheese, but they forgot added bacon, and uptown with American instead of Swiss and on an everything bagel).

Came to Tampa for three days and somehow ended up eating here twice. AMAZING experience from the incredibly kind owner to the delicious entrees. The lemon ice cream dessert will forever be on my mind.

Ordered enchiladas and steak fajitas with their traditional sauce. My wife thinks 3 stars and I think 4 stars. Her enchiladas were bitter (according to her) but I thought they were quite good. One slice of my steak fajitas was cold for some reason but the other pieces were good. First meal outside in a few months. Friendly waiter. +1 star during covid.

If u want that genuine, home cooked meal made by your new Korean momma, you better stop in and eat alllll the things. Excellent choices to choose from and quick service. Nothing but mad love for this place and the people who make it possible.

Meh. This place is merely okay. It's bland and fatty and the staff seemed to make mistake after mistake.  I didn't understand from other reviews that this isn't a dine-in breakfast place - it's a place where office workers downtown can grab something quick.  I really was not impressed.
Amazing food! Their burrito was huge & will definitely fill you up. No need for an appetizer. I've tried various items & none have disappointed. This is my favorite place so far.

If your a vegan, then this is the place for you. Very wide range of vegan options at an ok price. If your not vegan this place is a great option to grab a drink and a snack, maybe a cake or a samosa, but if you are look for a reasonably priced solid meal, go somewhere else. I have spent hours in Remedy drinking chai and eating samosas but if your planning on coming and not looking to spend much money- don't come too hungry. The price is simply not worth the amount. The food and drinks are very good but unless you want a specific dish there is cheaper options.

I took a weekend trip to meet my children after they got off the cruise ship.   The drinks were good as well as the pizza.  It's not the best I ever had, and not cheap at all for a slice, but I will go back when I am in town. They were very friendly and I think they remembered my children from the weekend before. LOL  Thank you for a good time and feeding us when we were drinking.  Oh they have jello shots in syrnges and they are huge.
Great drinks, bitchy hostesses, house band played everything great, but forgot to play any blues songs. Desserts were very good

My in-laws came to visit (from out of state) and ordered food from Fontana Pizza & Grill on the way to our apartment. The pizza was very good, but the fried chicken was AMAZING! I normally eat the mostly the batter/crispies off fried chicken, but in this case I ate the whole thing as the batter and the chicken we got were both delicious! Even the white meat was moist and tasty! We ordered the fried chicken again a few days ago, and it wasn't a fluke! This is truly some of the best fried chicken I've ever had! We will definitely be back! The garlic knots were lovely as well. Thank you!!!!
This place is amazing!  Cute outside patio, chill music, fast service and delicious unique food
I am a Celiac. Finding places that offer GF options that just aren't a salad or a bunless burger is rare. But here I have have a burger WITH a bun AND poutine. Fabulous.

I wish I could give no stars! Ordered door dash and the food was half of what we ordered and the meat was so chewy you couldn't cut it with a knife. Called and supervisor said that's how they cook their meat. Ok...... and he doesn't know why food was missing???? He then said I needed to take it up with door dash and hung up on me! WOW don't order from them. Plenty of good Mexican In Boise other than this.

My husband and I ordered from here for the first time last week. It was pretty good. We used to order from Evergreen but they seem to have gone downhill in the last few months. Absolutely loved that you could order from their website online. Food was delicious. We will definitely be ordering again soon. 

One downfall is that I placed an order to be delivered ahead of time (7:15pm) and it showed up at 6:15pm which is why I gave it 4 starts.

This place does pretty much only sandwiches, soup and salad but does them better than any place in town.  I usually get the turkey pesto or a grilled ham and cheese and out of the half dozen times I've been here, day or night, they are always polite, quick and efficient with my order and the food is always excellent.  

  It is a bit on the small side as far as seating goes so you should have a back up plan on where to sit and enjoy your meal if they are super busy.

  I crack up at people who complain about parking anywhere in Midtown.  I feel like these guys have never been to an actual big city before.  Yes, I guess it IS total torture to walk between a block to a block and a half.  If it's more than 6 feet from my car to the front door, I am going elsewhere.  Please...

Goodfellas is the perfect stop for crispy, thin crust pizza. I recommend sticking with one of their slices that you can buy straight from the case. On rare occasions, I have called ahead and ordered a pizza but that's only when you need to feed A LOT of people (or if it's Monday and 12" pizzas are half off!!!!). Trust me, 1 or 2 slices is enough to have you feeling full. I also am a huge fan of Goodfellas breadsticks which are absolutely massive. They also have buffalo ranch that is AMAZING. 

Incase you've never been to this location, there is also a bar located in the back of the restaurant. It is not obvious that it is there, but if you walk around the corner you can see that it is also a hidden gem.

Met a friend here for brunch and it was a little wait and  the parking lot was full so I had to seek street parking, But aside from that, I had a good experience. Staff was very nice and the waiter was attentive. Food was good. I started with a prickly pear mimosas and had the simple breakfast (bacon, eggs, potatoes and toast) with plain French toast. The bacon is thick and has this sweet syrup in it, very good! The potatoes were delicious! Seasoned and cooked all the way through.
PANDA is officially my favorite Chinese food anywhere! This location is fast & they give you what you want!

Walking down south street, we asked a woman pushing a baby carriage into her garage for her favorite local restaurant.  That's how we found this treasure.  The steamed spinach over Afghan rice (chalaw sabzi) was delicious. The yellow lentil soup was great every spoonful.  Ashak which are scallion dumplings with meat sauce was great. Recommended!

We ordered Shake Shack through post mates to deliver to nurses at CHOP. When the order was delivered, I confirmed with the driver that everything was there, she said she grabbed both bags that were given to her. The bags were sealed, upon opening them I realized there were no milkshakes. When calling the restaurant, the manager originally claimed that it was their fault as they forgot to give the milkshakes to the driver and if we could come get them. I told her that was not possible and that we wanted them delivered. The phone call was then disconnected. Many dials later, we get back in touch with the manager who changed her story to saying that they gave the milkshakes in the two bags and to take it up with PostMates. After debunking that claim, as the two bags were delivered and sealed, she refused to solve the problem and continued to put blame on PostMates. I will never order from here again as they are unreliable and unwilling to fix problems.

Wahoo! Whipped coffee is the bomb! Their house made whipped cream a top espresso and milk was delicious! You could really taste the vanilla bean as well. I could have just had a cup of the whipped cream if I didn't need my caffeine fix for an afternoon pick me up! This sweet treat is my new favorite and the shop looked so cute! It is currently pick up only so I couldn't go inside and explore but the online ordering process was a breeze. I can't wait to go back and eventually go inside! Thank you so much!!!

CJ's has great pizza and salads.  However, beware of ordering near closing time.  Their closing time is posted as 10:00 pm.  Twice I've tried ordering 15-20 minutes before closing (for salads one time, pizza and salad another time) and was told that they stop taking orders at 9:45.  Last night I tried placing an order at 9:40 (after sitting on hold for 4 minutes) and was told they were no longer taking orders.  Any other restaurant that I've ordered from takes orders until closing.  If they are going to stop taking orders at 9:45 (or even earlier), their hours should reflect this.

We moved to Boise from Brooklyn last fall and have been looking for our go-to sushi spot. After having tried pretty much everything else, can safely say that Island is definitely it. The fish is super fresh, the rolls have a good (light) balance of rice to fish, everything isn't covered with copious amounts of Mayo, etc. 

Of course if "all you can eat" is your thing there are better options, but if you want quality fish at reasonable prices, this is your spot. Highly recommended.

The seasonal menu is nice and etch offers some truly unique dishes! Nothing blew me away on the food menu but it has a nice ambiance and the dessert selection was actually pretty good. Reliable for a good meal with a chic feel but no dishes I was excited to tell my friends about.

Stopped in to have a refreshing margarita. My sister-in-law and I both got the skinny margarita s- omg! It was so awful!!! Our husbands got the casa margarita and they hated it! None of us could finish our drinks. We decided not to get food. 
Sooooo disappointing. 
Go to 5Agaves in Old Hickory -- so good!! And a lot cheaper!!!!
Excellent service, amazing food! Even with the COVID restrictions, the staff go out of their way to make their customers happy.

Everyone seemed confused as to what was going on.  They asked me 4 times what I ordered.  The wait was a little long, but definitely worth it once I got my food.  The pepperoni Stromboli was amazing.  One of the best I ever had.  I ordered the small size and it was definitely more than enough.  I don't live in the area and happened to pass by so I figured I would give it a try.  In my opinion, it was worth it.

This has the BEST Asian cuisine around! Wonderful shrimp wonton soup. You can't go wrong with any of their amazing entree options. Always cooked to perfection have never had a bad meal from here.  The owner is wonderful so helpful and kind. Highly recommend. Since covid they no longer offer sushi (which is understandable) but they are making every effort to limit contact and create a safe/clean environment. You won't regret a meal from here!

Waitress did not want to serve us. Walked passed us without any acknowledgement for 10-15 mins. When she finally came over to our table she told us there was a line waiting to be sat and we had to leave. We asked where the line was located because we would of patiently waited. she told us there were people waiting In their cars to be sat.. She did not offer to put us on that list. Nothing. Felt stereotyped and uncomfortable. We went over to the neighboring bars and felt more welcomed.

We moved up here from the south have been looking for a good BBQ place for a couple years now. We tried a bunch of different places and we're never really satisfied until we tried this. It is by far is the best we have had in Philly. The brisket and beef ribs were cooked very well, and both of the bbq sauces tasted great and had good consistency. The blueberry cornbread was something new to us and we loved it. We finally found our BBQ spot!

Awesome meal... our server, Dantaynia was polite, sweet and attentive. We used the waitlist check in through the Yelp app.... waited for like 2 mins.  Cool place barn tYPe decor. You receive a milk jug water decanter and the coffee pot at your table. 

We will be back!

What a truly inspiring menu! Something for everybody. The dishes are as tasty as they are healthy. An uplifting atmosphere and positive attitude from all staff make for a truly great experience. I highly recommend the crack bowl (available in chicken and vegan).
Cute dessert spot in Chinatown! Good variety of desserts and drinks on the menu. I highly recommend anything mango flavored!

Super friendly staff. Quick service. Hope they're able to get a larger space though. We had 9 people in our party and everyone enjoyed what they got. The Vaso Loco was definitely a cool purchase and my daughter really enjoyed it.

One of the best south Indian restaurant with multiple food options, amazing taste, pleasant ambience and excellent hospitality. They took additional responsibility during this Covid times and made sure they met the hygiene levels. The manager Praveen is quite friendly, very quick and responsive. 
Chicken 65, dum biryani, cut mirch and gulab jamun were super tasty. I highly recommend this place!!

I came here for a birthday dinner, thinking we could order a bunch of plates and share them. 
The outside seating was beautiful, aside from the hookah smoke traveling our way. The service was incredibly slow, that we portioned out water until we could get more. 
The food overall was okay. The falafel was dry without much flavor. The chicken was nicely blackened but needed a lot of dip/sauce. But for how much it all cost, i expected much bigger portions and better flavor.

This is a place you don't want to miss on your visit to Nashville! The BBQ is good, the view will make it even sweeter, but nothing makes it feel like home like the hospitality of Mike and Carrol! I got the 3 meat plate - brisket, ribs, and chicken- with Mac and Cheese, beans, and sweet tea. The seating outside gives a front view of the marina, and the blues band plays on a Saturday. I'm a newcomer, but this is my favorite local spot.

Corners is pretty good if you are looking for pan pizza in the channelside area. Each pizza is a single serving, but could be shared if you just need a quick snack while drinking and enjoying the Warf.  The staff is super friendly and accommodating, they even kept a beer that I bought cold for me as I ate my meal.

Great food and service as always. Didn't notice until we'd already gotten our food, but half the staff doesn't wear masks over their nose and a smaller handful of the staff doesn't cover their mouths either. This include kitchen staff.

Short take: I won't be coming back here.

Longer take: I brought my family her to celebrate my son's birthday. Based on the recommendations from friends, we were hoping for a fun friendly atmosphere. We did not get that. The host and hostess were both rude and short. One of the hostess was sitting down in the kitchen talking to someone else in the staff when I told her that our party was ready to be seated. She moved so slowly, I didn't think she even heard me. I went and told someone else that we were ready and then she got upset that I asked someone and said she heard me.

I asked that they sing the birthday song for my son. This song and ice cream didn't come out until AFTER they brought out the checks and paid the bill.

The food was just okay. Not very well seasoned. 

Definitely do not recommend. We won't return.

REALLY tasty pizza. Crisp but not crumbly crust, delicious sauce and cheese. I got the Square thin pie with hot sausage and long hots as toppings, which definitely gave it a good kick. This pizza tastes more real/less gourmet. Just the way I like it. Nice job!!

stopped in 11-13-19 to have breakfast at 6 am ( open 24 hours according to the sign).  NO ONE in the place except an employee who looked like she was re stocking some stuff in the kitchen .. I waited, and waited, she looked at me and kept working. after about 7 or 8 minutes I walked out.  Very disappointed

I am so disappointed with this restaurant.  I had several issues last night which means I will be taking a break from getting takeout from here.  

First -  re: COVID   The whole restaurant was packed.  No way they are operating at 50% capacity.  The place is so small and crowded that I am unsure if it's even safe to pick up my orders since the people eating are not wearing masks at tables very close to the register line.   

Second - re: COVID:  One of the cooks was wearing a mask around his chin.

Third - My order was not prepared as requested.   

Lastly - The fries are always burnt.  They used to be the best in town but something changed.  

Time for a change.   I hope those concerned about COVID will think twice about going here, at least on the weekends.

My wife and I just stopped in for a late lunch. Food was fresh, filling, and very tasty. Staff was very friendly and willing to explain all the options, including throwing in a few samples to ensure we liked our orders. Will definitely be going back.
Service was great, food was amazing, drinks were fabulous!!! Fish spread is a must!!!!! Best fish spread i've ever had!

The atmosphere in the evening is wonderful.  If you'd rather dine outside, all the better.  Food is excellent and staff is very attentive.  Parking at times can be a bit limited.  It's best to arrive somewhat early for your reservation.

How have I never been here before?

I had lunch at Thai Mint today and here's how it went.:

I was greeted immediately and shown to my table. The menu I was given was chock full of very reasonably priced lunch dishes complete with all of the Thai favorites you'd hope to find.  

I went with the chicken pad Thai lunch portion and it was fantastic!  I had no idea that my lunch would come with a fried spring roll and soup. Both were delicious. All of that for 8.95!

From the service to the food, there wasn't a misstep.  Everything was great and I know I'll be returning very soon.

Loved our breakfast this morning. Had two sandwiches.. one with the biscuit and the other with the potato roll. Bread was amazing! I also had a hazelnut mocha latte and it was delicious. Service was quick and friendly. Interior is beautiful and so relaxing. We will definitely come back!
Slow Server and Cook!  I saw a guy been awaiting for hours for his food and had to go catch their flight. Server is not pay attention to our drink

A buddy of mine told me about this place, and we decided to make the trek up to Noblesville to see if it was as good as the reviews say. I can say, it is that and more! 

I went with the "All In", and topped it off with sausage gravy. Ava's potatoes and everything but the kitchen sink mixed in. This thing is massive, and by the time I couldn't take another bite, my plate looked like I barely made a dent. The endless free toast might have filled me up a bit, but there was no way I could finish it all in one sitting. They have a challenge which is the same meal, just 2x the portion size...I couldn't fathom someone being able to complete that challenge.

The girlfriend got the "Little Oscar" which is an eggs Benedict with your choice of meat (she chose corned beef) and topped with sausage gravy. She said it was the best she's ever had! I plan on trying that the next time we go, which will be soon!

We also tried the cinnamon sugar rolls, which were 50 cents a pop, so no longer unlimited... :(  They were pretty tasty, likened to a cinnamon/sugar version of the typical Chinese restaurant sugar donut. They serve them with apple butter packets, which makes for a delightful combo. 

Bottom line..This place is a sure bet. Get it?!?

Stayed here in February for a conference.  Disappointed to say the least.  When arrived in room pulled back sheets to find a blood stain on the mattress cover.  The thing is, it was very visible to me once I pulled back the comforter so I'm sure housekeeping saw it.  Further disappointed that when the manager came to the room he just had the housekeeper change the sheets as if I still wanted to sleep on a mattress where someone had bled.  I had to go to the front desk and speak to manager who finally changed my room.  But still there was no offer to compensate me in any way for the inconvenience of having to see a blood stained sheet or having to move.  I finally was told by someone at the front desk to write a letter to the manager, which presumably was received as one night was removed from bill.  But no call, no apologies.  On top of this, my Burberry scarf and iPod was stolen out of my room.  I reported the scarf and of course it was never found and no one followed up with me despite me calling security several times.  I didn't realize after returning home - with the flu- that the iPod was missing.  Overall I don't know how this place has received so many great reviews.  The room wasn't clean and there were damaged walls/doors.  I certainly would never stay here again.

I stopped by this location today because I saw an ad that they were new to the area , and offering free entrees with a purchase of any drink. This held true! I love Indian food, so I was excited to try this place. I've never been to their other location on 10th street but heard good things. 

The venue is nice. I wish I could have captured more pictures but it was busy and I didn't want the guest to feel weird that I was taking their pics. I enjoyed the ordering process. Reminds you of Chipotle but with Indian style food. I ordered the chicken tikka Marsala rice bowl, and added a few veggies, plus the spicy tomato sauce, and a side of Naan. 

The food was tasty. My only complaint was that the food wasn't hot, it was luke warm. I like my food pipping hot. Other than that it was a good experience.
What a great place for an after race gathering. Whether it's brunch or lunch, you can't go wrong here.

Gosh I wanted to like this place. The atmosphere was good, very kid friendly. Service was as expected, nothing more nothing less. The food was such a disappointment. I do realize that this is a chain Restuarant, but my oh my, why is the food so bland. The seafood was frozen not fresh and the veggies were bland. The ribs did not fall of the bone and the rice was dry. I typically like to give restaurants a second try, but not sure if I can muster up the courage to visit Saltgrass again

Great tacos, good customer service. The fish tacos were very well made and the sauce they provide was a good compliment. They even offered to bring food out to our car so we didn't have to wait in the cold or keep coming out. Will def be back !

Jim boys always our first stop when in Reno or Sacramento. 
It's been our families favorite for years and although we no longer live in the area we still crave the beef tacos.

I don't enjoy going to eat at a place where me ordering food, getting a refill and asking for hot sauce is an inconvenience to the entitled highschooler behind the counter. If you don't want to help customers, get out of customer service. Thank for showing me the definition of horrendous customer service.

Now that the Keg near my house has shut down, I needed to find another good steak place. I tried this place out and was hella impressed. I found the staff were quite willing to do whatever needs be to keep the customers happy. I saw this happening at my table and others so it seems to be consistent.

The food here is tasty and the drinks (albeit I only tried the virgin cocktails) were artistic. I would highly recommend the rib eye
house-smoked with alder, apple & hickory, a cut I would never normally eat. But the way they treat it, I am salivating just thinking about it. It is a MUST.

There is a chocolate dessert that I fell in love with. Fallen Chocolate Soufflé Cake. I had to have two. 

Pro-tip: the bathrooms (at least the ladies) have two doors out going to different places....so make sure you keep track of which one you came in.
Great place! The food was excellent, I had the Margherita pizza and caprese appetizer. Our server was hillarious!  This is a great addition to downtown Safety Harbor. I will definitely be back.

My absolute favorite place to go for burritos. Nothing beats it. Hopefully they pull through this covid era and go back to regular hours! Also, I've never had a better salsa then their dark red salsa (spicy).

I Have mixed reviews, I usually go here and its always great. On New years we booked a table for 8, our table was tucked in a corner with no elbow space to eat, we ordered a round of drinks and appetizers, this took forever, but whatever we were not in a rush. My table got a little loud I understand this is semi finer dining for some, but my friends and family are French Canadian and they are just louder then usual. They decided to cut the entire table off for drinking to much as they said we were belligerent. We had one drink at this point. We ended up leaving they were not able to get the bill ready and embarrassed my entire group in front of the entire restaurant. It is unfortunate because my husband and I got there at least once a month and sit at the bar with the very pleasant bartender. We have never had issues before but this was unsettling. I will not return.

I work in the industry and Tupelo honey has mastered the sanitization! This is one of the few restaurants that I would feel comfortable going out to dine in. Great ambiance, fantastic food, and great service:)

What a great place! Our server, Laura, did an awesome job of guiding us through the menu and was super sweet! We all enjoyed our dishes and were especially pleased with the quesadillas. Usually places skimp on shrimp, but their shrimp quesadillas are stuffed full of big shrimp! Good prices, awesome service, really good food :-)

First time eating here and I'll be back at least once a week!  The butter chicken was amazing and best naan bread I've had. Our server was very nice and helpful with ordering, also there is plenty of food for leftovers tomorrow, yum!

I have been looking for some really good street style Mexican food ever since I moved here and finally found it! The beef mulitas were great and their guacamole was so fresh and chunky. I can't wait to go back, this will definitely be my new spot!

We decided to give it another try after going when it first opened and didn't like it. This time was worse. I got an Italian beef with gravy and peppers... Well 2 slices of peppers to be exact. It was literally the most underwhelming and flavorless think I've ever eaten. My wife got the Italian sausage and peppers, it was shriveled and overcooked and... Again, 2 peppers... Is there a worldwide pepper shortage I'm not aware of? And why am I paying $.60 for peppers??? My mother got a regular beef hot dog, which was also underwhelming. Fries were ok, onion rings were burnt and hard... It wasn't busy...Who let this stuff out of the kitchen? That's just poor management and supervision. Never again going to Portillos.

I dined at Malios on Tuesday June 23. Although the food and service was great, I was very disappointed they did not wear masks. They explained they were distancing and that was good enough. NOT good enough. I won't go back until that policy is corrected. 
Nell
Quetzally catered an event for me.  Everything was fantastic!  The food was absolutely delicious.  My guests raved about it.  I can't wait to eat here again!

5 stars for this cute coffee joint! I came in on a quiet Tuesday a little after noon and there wasn't a line. Very clean, well designed space with the coffee bar as the centerpiece. There's a great selection of different coffees that go way beyond just dark and blonde roasts, and the staff did an awesome job of guiding me through my options as this was my first visit. I ordered a bourbon vanilla flavored iced latte with extra espresso, and while I'm hesitant to try flavored lattes for fear of them being too sugary, this one was the perfect balance. Not too sweet and all the flavors blended with the espresso well. I also ordered a brioche cinnamon roll that is to die for. Every bite tastes like the middle of the cinnamon roll! I certainly won't be going out of my way for Starbucks anymore. 10/10 would recommend. Thanks Andy!

Omg the worst place I have eaten !!!  My husband ordered the burger well done it showed up almost rare.  I ordered the chicken chili .   It was luke warm , had absolutely no taste .   The waitress did not even notice I did not touch my food .  The waitress and others were all busy talking not even noticing the clients .   My husband went to the restroom and said it was disgusting.   I'm so bummed  that this was a waste of money!!    I will never come back nor recommend this
Amazing coffee spot from when I stayed at the Old No 77 Hotel. Great selection and great service, definitely recommend stopping by!

All I can say is WOW!! Greated, sat, and taken care of by the owner.... Who does that any more these days? Definitely more of a bistro atmosphere, than your average pizza joint. The food was fresh, it was nice to have it prepared by a staff that takes the time to make it 100% the way it should be. My wife had pizza, I had the seafood carpaccio. Cozy, quiet, and comfortable. Will definitely be a regular spot to take her to (date night ). Will only improve once the beer starts flowing, soon I heard. Well done!

We stopped and didn't know anything about this place. It's nice and affordable. The oysters were perfect and tasty. I gave them 4 stars because they should have had a vinegar mix to eat with oysters. Maybe next time.

I placed an order for take out during the Covid19 pandemic and while picking up my order the establishment was very considerate of the guidelines to stay safe. They even included a face mask with a thank you note. The sushi was phenomenal and always is. The delicate quality of the sashimi is top of the line and the flavors that are incorporated in the dishes are matched perfectly. Also, when dining in at Hikari Sushi something about the flavor of soy sauce is different than any other that I have tasted, truly one of a kind.  I highly recommend Hikari Sushi!
good food all around. The url above is incorrect, this is their website http://www.thaibaysushi.com

Tasty tacos however terribly overpriced. 
Small menu, limited choices. Clean, well maintained establishment.

The wait was long and a bit away from where we and most stay when visiting but the food was amazing and specialty drinks were very good.  If you have time to drive and wait patiently for great food, go here.

I had a great time with my girlfriends tonight! Trip #5! Our server, nicholas, was a delight and very attentive! I had the brussel sprouts, baseball sirloin, and the french 75 cocktail! My girlfriend enjoyed the rib eye appetizer and her wine! I'll definitely be back!

Just soooo OK. I wanted it to be the greatest salad ever. It wasn't. But that said, I will go again and try a different salad. Maybe the next one will be fantastic. But this experience was just an OK salad and a big price.

First time visit in Feb.  Alexis was waitress.  Not to sound "mean" though suspect waitressing will not be a career path for this young lady.   Screwed up 3 separate things during my visit.  Pressing forward, ordered an alfredo pasta dish - the WORSE !  SAVE YOUR MONEY - learn through my mistake.  Garlic knots nasty.  Should have had a sling shot.  They were hard enough I could have knocked a squirrel out of a tree.   If this is an indicator of the rest of the pasta dishes on the menu, then I am mildly surprised scratching my head trying to figure out how this place is still in business.  My guess it maybe the pizza.  Will give it one more try for the pizza.  Bottom line, service (waitress) and food not good.

The food is horrible and the manager here is awful. Instead of helping resolve the issue, the manager was rude, attacking, and spoke very poorly of HER staff.

Order from Pizza Hut or Round Table instead, or make the drive into town and get something local. I hope this store gets closed again.

My boyfriend and I tried to order a couple drinks at around 9 PM after a great dinner at Jane's Hideaway. They thought my boyfriend's ID was fake even though he had multiple ID's to show and he's 24. We had no issue getting drinks at any other place, but got "kicked out" of this spot. I guess it's their loss, not ours as we just went back to Jane's Hideaway which I highly reccommend!

I've lived in Florida for a long time and have lived all over the state. Due to this, I am very hesitant to heap praise on a seafood restaurant. I will say though, honestly, the Mr. and Mrs. crab Special sauce/seasoning in the Seafood bag with crab legs, lobster, Etc. Was perhaps the best seafood meal I have ever had. It reminded me of a place I love in Fort Lauderdale called the Rustic Inn...but even better.  I got mine seasoned extra hot and it was fantastic. I will be back and be bringing friends!

this what they call grill chicken Cesar salad? So soggy,smells awful and my god just look at the presentation. Like seriously this is what I payed $10.00 for? Money wasted ,going right in the trash,never again will I order take out or even visit this place. It's just so unreal!! I would give zero stars but yelp wouldn't let me
Great "mexican" food, we have both been inside and ordered for delivery. A friend recommended it to us and we love it.

Im an italian whose fathers side is from philly. I was hungry for real italian sfogliatelle so I looked online and found Termini Bros and they could ship these delicious pastries right to my front door.
OF COURSE i ordered them and they arrived today in perfect condition due to the tray they use to pack them in. EACH large sfogliatelle was in absolute perfect condition and all I need to do is bake them for a few minutes to make them oven crispy and dust them with some powered sugar and eat!
I am so grateful that Termini Bros delivers all the way to florida during this pandemic. I cant wait to try one as they are made in philly and the altitude and water is different than floridas water and sea level altitude.
Thanks Termini Bros for letting me have a true italian delicasy delivered to my doorstep! Stay well!
Good service, food is hit and miss but the music playlist is like smelling a fart while you're trying to convince yourself the mediocre sushi is premium...needs a performance improvement plan..

This hidden gem is worth the drive up Broad St away from the downtown hustle and bustle. This was my first time here, but a heads up for ordering during Covid times you can order in person or through their website. The ordering process was very simple and even gave an estimated pickup time about a 45 minute wait. I arrived a couple minutes early and my order was ready. The staff was friendly, welcoming and busy cooking up the good stuff. 

I ordered the shrimp Po boy sandwich and it was bursting with flavor. The presentation was beautiful it was funny trying to figure out exactly how to tackle this beauty without dropping all the goodness out. The shrimp were cooked and seasoned perfectly and the italian roll was a good garlicky crunch. I actually could have the sandwich served not put together just so you can separate the flavor bombs from the fried shrimp to the bread. I would definitely come back and would like to try their other options and perhaps give another slamming review. 

When I called they informed me they close at 8pm, BUT stop taking orders at 7:30pm.

This is our go to place!!! It's amazing!!!! 
The food is delicious, and the ambiance is great!!! 
Lots of outdoor seating and the area is very big looks like a park and has a big sandy area for the kids to play. 
The front of the restaurant outdoor seating is nice because it's the dog area and they also have a very nice adults only area which is nice to get away from screaming kids. 
Amazing burgers!!! I highly recommend the pretzel burger, it is delicious. They are very accommodating as well with changing the patty's to veggie or making an substitutions. The California burger Is something we have gotten as well and it's just as good. 
They also have a full vegan menu!!! But be careful asking for an substitutions they will up charge you like crazy!!
The only thing that I would say they need to work on is the amount they charge on substitutions!!! A Vegan cheeseburger is $10 dollars and change the pretzel burger is $7.50 How do they end up charging a burger that is $7.50 to $10 something just for changing the patty to a veggie patty??? That was over 3 dollars they charged me just for that substitution!?!?!?! And when I have tried to order the Vegan cheeseburger and asking for the pretzel bun again they charge 3 plus??? 
I understand up charging but that much??? Little ridiculous!! Especially for bread!!!

Don't come here if you expect or are looking forward to eating at an all you can eat place. I've been here multiple times and only once have I experienced this place as "all you can eat" due to short staff. Other than that, service and food is good. It just advertises as an "all you can eat" place when it's not consistently that. If you're really looking forward to AYCE sushi, call before coming to make sure they aren't short staffed.

Wow! I haven't had this great of Chinese food in years. I got their Chow Mein and Kung Pao Tofu. It was incredible. They offer very large portions and do not use MSG, as well. 

I would like to this restaurant using different packaging (maybe just a standard to-go box) as styrofoam never biodegrades and can't be recycled. 

Nevertheless, I highly recommend this restaurant!

Always excellent service, amazing food and great draft selection. Decor is welcoming and cozy, ample bar seating with split interior and exterior sections. Has a large outdoor patio dining area as well. They also stay open till 11:00 pm on weekdays which is later than most likewise dining options in the area.

Came here during this whole COVID situation. 
Got crawfish to go, and it was delicious! I usually like my crawfish spicy and juicy. I think Seither's crawfish is not too spicy (definitely still a kick to it, but not as spicy as I've had from other places) I also think the crawfish can be juicier, but it might be because their crawfish are bigger, so it's a little less juicy? Regardless, this is my go-to for take our crawfish. Current price for boiled crawfish is $3.99/lb.
The food was great, the prices were great. The outside dining is amazing in summer. Def a great place to plan celebrating any milestone
Hands down the only game in town, if you're looking for a true pizza joint. Full bar, great pie, good vibes.

Excellent! Stopped in for dinner tonight. 
First my husband and I shared a vegetarian salad which the server (owner ?) suggested we add feta cheese to. It was made fresh with a light vinaigrette dressing and feta cheese. Huge portion more than enough for 2. Seriously better than any Greek salad I have tried in this town. Then we split schnitzel (pork) and kase wurst platters. The schnitzel was our favorite. Huge portion. Absolutely delicious! The French fries were super. Wernesgruner beer was perfect with the meal. 
We had an apple knodle for dessert which our server suggested we order when we ordered dinner. It was tasty and served warm but I suggested it would be better if he served it with vanilla ice cream. 
Our server told us they had only been open one month. We wish the much successWe will definitely be back.
Update:
Returned this evening
 with our 2 adult daughters and 2 year old granddaughter.
The owner couldn't have been more accommodating. My daughter ordered a vegetarian panini for my granddaughter and the owner said that would be huge for the toddler. He said he would put together a plate for her. He came back to the table with a platter of humus, cut up raw vegetables and delicious bread for our toddler immediately. Our dinners were delicious again. Schnizel, currywurst, French fries, potato salad and salads. Did not charge us for my granddaughter's dinner.  Lovely restaurant. Excellent for families.

Every once in a while a good place strikes out, and so it was for Jimmy Kelly's last night (2/28/2020). My SO had a great meal with the fried calamari, Salad, Sea Bass with fresh asparagus coupled with a nice claret. She was delighted. I had the Jimmy Kelly Cheese Burger. I know, I know, why go to a steak house and have a burger. Because it sounded so good from the menu. It was terrible. Dry. Over-grilled. The condiments serviced on the side could not save it. 

Go to Jimmy Kelly's, but avoid the burger!
Delicious sandwiches served here. Got the BLAST and was very impressed especially with a touch of salmon in there very cool idea. Sandwich was fresh and filling as well.

It was the BEST place we tried during our trip. It was so awesome we went there twice!! Highly recommend the Shrimp Tchefuncte and the crab cheesecake (more like a quiche) Loved the atmosphere and the service.

I love all the varieties of pizza they have. Last week I couldn't decide between wings or pizza so I had both with the upstate buffalo pizza which has a buffalo sauce base, chicken, bacon, celery and a ranch drizzle. My son had the BBQ chicken pizza. My husband had the monster Stromboli for takeout and it looked so good I know what I am getting next time.

Very pleased with my experience at CAVA! I wasn't familiar with the set-up or many of the ingredients or dressings, but the staff were so friendly in helping me craft a custom bowl. As I walked down the line thinking about what I'd want in my meal, I was impressed by how fresh all the produce looked. I ended up getting mixed greens, black lentils, chicken, and an assortment of other add ins and dressings. To put it simply, I was blown away by just how good everything tasted! Not only were all the ingredients tasty individually, but the employees helped me create something that tasted good as a whole.

I also think it's worth noting that CAVA has really great juices and teas available. When I was there, they had a refreshing mint lemonade drink that I had a few refills of. If you end up going here and are looking for a refreshing drink (other than water) to go with your meal, definitely take a peak at what they have available.

While it seemed expensive for a family of six, the quality was good. I asked for a flavored tea, and since they have a bar, that should have been easy to accommodate, it wasn't. 
The waitress was nice but very not very observant or helpful. Another waiter had to assist when one of the eco cups were leaking all over, she never even offered to wipe the table from the milk spill. 
The atmosphere is great and visually appealing, I would be interested to do a date night and see how different the staff is. Maybe day shifts are not a good fit for some of them.

Been there twice once for dinner and once for weekend brunch. It's really just normal... first time ordered a risotto, which supposed to come with pouched eggs. They fully cooked the eggs with hard yolk.... took the dish back to remake the egg but never came out until my friend already finished his dish... to apologize the manager gave me two free coupon for appetizers. So I Visited again for weekend brunch menu. Everything is just normal that you can get from anywhere. The pickled shrimp might be the most creative dish. With that jar, it's super inconvenient. If you want to eat the pickled you need to remove the shrimps first. Otherwise, the shrimp would just fall off when you try to grab the pickle... shrimps were not fully cleaned either. Still had part of the dirty vein was still there.... won't visit again. Don't recommend.

Food was excellent and so was the service. 
Had a nice and relaxed vibe, I'll definitely eat there again and would certainly recommend it to anyone who likes good food.

Ok so I go in to get breakfast for me and julie(she had surgery yesterday so I just wanted to get her something) I walk in and a family is behind me. I go to the counter to order and the waitress comes over to me to get my order. The owner tells her to go to the family before me. She didn't hear him and takes my order. He proceeds to berate her in front of me 5 TIMES. No matter how much she apologized he wouldn't stop. Then tells her to go explain to the family why it took so long to get their order and that she doesn't listen!!! (1 minute maybe) so I've had enough! I tell him I will go tell the family and how rude he is to treat her this way especially in front of customers. He says don't tell me what to do and I told him I've watched him treat his staff like shit for years and I will NEVER come back and told him in front of the entire restaurant to go f**k himself and walked out. Why in world would treat your staff and customers this way? #bekindalways
Everything was good esp the steak and the shrimp. The cocktail that was made of mezcal was very good as well! I would def go back!

One of our favorite local spots. Most recently visited during a cold spell, and sat outside due to COVID. They were very accommodating to turn on the heaters for us and find items on the menu that fit our dietary restrictions. 
We ate the loaded tostones, chicken wings, and brussel sprouts. Each item was 5 star!
Another great meal from Pomodoro. Pizza is the best. Keep up the good work guys and stay safe. My go to spot for pizza.

I have been to all of the Trident locations in town and I like them. This was just a bad experience though. I came on a Sunday evening to watch Sunday Night Football. The bar was understaffed - the lone bartender was out of her depth. I didn't get served for a full 10 minutes after arriving, so I reached over the bar top to get my own menu, and the long waits continued for the rest of my visit.

Then 75% of the TVs were blank screens (since the earlier games had ended) and the remaining 25% were showing local news/weather. These latter ones were connected to the audio in the building, so everyone was just listening to the forecast for the week - a real mood-crusher for a sports bar. This went on for about 15-20 minutes. So I asked if they could at least change the one connected to audio to the pregame show. I got attitude from the bartender and snarky comments from an off-shift employee sitting at the bar (spoken to the bartender, but in response to my request, so directed at me).

A couple tips to the "sports" bar:
- Have sports on your TV - a novel idea, I know (and make sure the employees know how to work the remote).
- Don't have your employees sitting at the bar after their shift drinking, vaping, flirting with other employees, and making smartass comments to your patrons.
- Make sure you have enough bartenders staffed on NFL Sundays... at a sports bar!!

Love the other Trident locations, but disappointed with this one.

The food and apps are are great.  Drinks are good.  The service is fast and friendly.  The only negative I have is that it's small and can be very crowded.  My only recommendation would be to not go during peak times.  Definitely enjoyed the food and ambiance otherwise.
Great family cooking. Good pricing, friendly service. Food is good and many options to choose from. Service is quick whether you eat in or carry out. Would definitely go back.

Belgium waffle: 1/5
There was only one strawberry cut into four pieces on the waffle. For $11 we expected a bit more toppings. Also the batter tasted like it was straight from a Costco shelf. This was on par with UCSB dining commons food. Big let down.

Breakfast club sandwich: 5/5
This is a BIG MUST. My roommate and I LOVED this and finished it in around 5 minutes because it was SO GOOD. We added avocado to it at home and it definitely elevated the sandwich. I love that they put cheese on both the top and bottom bread slices. We got ours with sourdough which I think added to the flavor of everything overall. Also the side of potatoes was also fantastic, we love yam and really enjoyed that addition. The potatoes were soft and not oily, they tasted light but still savory. I would come back just for the potatoes.
The tastiest Moroccan meal!!!  Warm, fresh, and great presentation.  They were on top of it with covid precautions, they had outdoor seating and got seated right away.  I can't wait to go back.

The food was really good! I got the Cajun kale salad and the oyster tacos, which was more than enough to fill me up for dinner. The drinks were very good as well. Definitely recommend the garlic crab claws - the sauce they're in is to die for and there are enough crab legs to share amongst 4/5 people. 

Our waitress was okay - she was not very attentive on drinks or cleaning up our dirty plates etc. but she was sweet and seemed a bit timid. Not sure if she was new or not, but a lively waiter can definitely enhance a dining experience. The manager was great and very friendly.
We are not ones to leave amazing reviews but the food here is the best boil ever. Get the Combo C!! So good
This is a VERY classy restaurant. The food was on point, and the drinkers were delicious. I didn't see any cougars, but I'm afraid of large cats anyways. Would definitely stop by again.

We tried four different taco's and two sides. While all the food was good we didn't find anything amazing. Rock Shrimp and Fish taco's were fresh and the Duck and Pork Belly were tasty, but nothing exceptional. Yes, the taco's are small, but they are only charging 2.50 a taco while Cantena Laredo charges almost double that.  The Ginger Mint iced tea was very sweet and would get something different next time. One of the nice things is a carafe of iced tea is only 1.50. The slaw side was fresh with a nice dressing and the beans side was a decent size. Waiter was not the best, but all in all we would go back again.

Updating my review because I gotta deliver some praise! The gentleman taking my order was FANTASTIC! With a family of 5, and with several requests, I always dread ordering. He was fast, polite, and knew his stuff. I thanked him, but it deserves to be shared. Food was wonderful as usual. And the crispy tenders were a surprise hit.

The service here is absolutely atrocious. I called in a to-go order, they gave me a 20-minute time. Before it will be done and when I arrive there I sat at the front counter for 15 minutes, unacknowledged, and then proceeded to wait another 20 minutes before I got my food. I will no longer be supporting this establishment as I feel that I am not valued as a customer and cannot reward this type of service.

This is my go to place in New Orleans. It's just north of the airport. I've been coming here for decades. It was a tiny place but the have expanded over the years. Tonight I had oysters first and I must say they were very fresh and extremely tasty and good for you too. Form my entree I had the royal red shrimp, so flavorful, tender and sweet. If you like seafood you're going to love this place. If I'm right comment. Bon appétit.
There popular chocolate covered donut has less and less chocolate on top each time I go there...I might have to go somewhere else to get a properly frosted donut.
